name: Jewel Christmas
author: Addicting Games
description: Jewel Christmas is a festive matching game for Christmas lovers! This is a Christmas-themed matching game where you can match gingerbreads, Christmas bulbs, Christmas trees, and stockings. There are four modes you can play: Infinity, Action, Escape, Downfall, and Blocker. Infinity is for never-ending matching fun for those who want a more carefree game. Action is for a time-limited round with goals to reach each level. In Escape, you must match bubbled decorations to advance to the next level. In  Downfall you must get the stars from the top to the bottom. Lastly, Blocker is destroying all the decorations in the blocks by matching them. Each mode has its own scoreboard with your best score. The games with levels get harder and harder as you match along in this easy online game.
